validity.researcher_notes: Pipeline is real and built (designer page, servitude notice, GTRK Smolensk 2023-12-11). Classification: a branch from Torzhok-Minsk-Ivatsevichi trunk taps to an AGRS is transmission under the GRS rule; sheet says distribution. Endpoint name variant 'Nikitenki' vs Nikitino (Demidov district). Length: designer 67.031 km vs ~63 km (Smolensk 2020 plan footnote; thesis) vs '>60' press. Capacity 0.08 bcm/y only matches a thesis figure (84.07 mln Nm3/y GRS annual volume). Not a duplicate; it taps the Torzhok-Minsk-Ivatsevichi strings (P5654/P5655).
